$comment: Desktop compatibility sweep round 6: the next 30 Chrome Web Store extensions by install count after the top 30 of round 1, the 30 of next30.json, the 30 of next30-round3.json, the 30 of next30-round4.json and the 30 of next30-round5.json (ranks 151-180; the harness at /tmp/zen-compat reads this list; manifests under the project store internal/extensions/next30-round6/). Counts are the store detail pages' rounded figures read 2026-09-21; ties inside one rounded bucket are ordered by the page's rating count. Candidates came from the store's category listings and keyword searches, about 11,700 detail pages probed across rounds 3 to 6 (this round added 187 search terms and 856 new detail pages, which surfaced one new rankable 1,000,000 item, ColorPick Eyedropper at 1.2K ratings, below the cut). The rounded 2,000,000 bucket's three rankable leftovers from round 5 (The QR Code Generator, Cookie-Editor, Browsing Protection by WithSecure) take ranks 151-153; ranks 154-180 are the rounded 1,000,000 bucket's 27 rankable items with the most ratings (the cut falls between Keywords Everywhere at 5.7K and PrintFriendly at 5.5K). Not ranked: themes (Morpheon Dark), Chrome Apps (Google Classroom), organisation-managed or organisation-login-only items (Endpoint Verification, ClassLink OneClick, Clever, Mobility Print, Lightspeed Insight Agent, Okta Browser Plugin, Trellix Endpoint Security Web Control, LearnPlatform for Students, OpenText Content Server Browser Web Extension, My Apps Secure Sign-in Extension, MasteryConnect LockDown Browser, HID Credential Management Extension, LanSchool Web Helper, iboss Cloud Connector) and Google items whose detail pages publish no user count.
